prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in steps consistently degraded performance and triggered guardrail rollbacks.
Finish screen layout changes consistently hurt performance, resulting in negative impacts or rollbacks.
Sign-in redesigns consistently underperformed, producing multiple losses and no winning tests.
Sign-in hints, adoption new screens, and home wait-info changes proved helpful, driving multiple winning tests, though many tests in these categories showed no clear effect.
Predictions were systematically too optimistic for failing changes, redesigns, and guardrail rollbacks.
Predictions systematically underestimated the gains achieved by winning tests.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] sign_in_same_account_pet_preservation_hint: Adds a prominent hint on the sign-in screen reminding users to sign in with their original account to preserve existing pets and saved progress. (why: Support receives frequent emails (8 tickets) regarding pets missing or accounts resetting after signing back in, indicating users accidentally create or sign into secondary accounts.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] new_pet_behavior_preview_screen: Adds a dedicated preview screen right after pet selection showing how the pet moves, sits, and reacts on the desktop. (why: Adoption has a 74.5% conversion rate and support receives multiple queries post-onboarding about how to interact with or control the desktop pet.)
2: [home, wait_info] waiting_desktop_visibility_diagnostic_wait_info: Displays real-time render status and display troubleshooting tips while the desktop pet is generated. (why: The waiting step has high mean time (2336s) and 3 support emails reported pets failing to appear on the desktop after setup.)
3: [finish, hint] home_intro_desktop_interaction_cheatsheet_hint: Provides a clear summary hint on the finish screen explaining how to summon, control, or hide the desktop pet. (why: Finish screen has the lowest conversion rate (64.8%) with median 395s, and support reported user confusion around pet controls after onboarding.)
4: [adoption, new_flow] adoption_photo_quality_verification_new_flow: Inserts a photo quality verification screen after photo upload to confirm lighting and subject clarity before generation. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected rendering outcomes during photo-based adoption.)
5: [choose_path, hint] story_welcome_companion_overview_hint: Adds an explanatory hint on the story screen introducing how desktop pets companion you during work. (why: Story screen mean duration is high, so giving users immediate context about desktop pet benefits speeds up initial understanding.)
6: [finish, notification] home_intro_desktop_pet_ready_notification: Triggers a notification badge on the final screen confirming the pet is active and visible on the desktop. (why: Finish screen drop-off is high (64.8% conversion) as users hesitate without explicit confirmation that their pet is ready.)
7: [home, redesign] waiting_pet_generation_stage_redesign: Redesigns the waiting screen into a stage layout with live render progress indicators. (why: The waiting step has a long mean duration (2336s); a stage layout with clear visual progress keeps users visually informed.)

scores.note: Sign-in hints have strong track record (+2.1% across 7 tests) and direct support ticket evidence (8 tickets).
Adoption step has moderate drop-off, but adding a new screen requires release build and historically yields flat results (-0.2%).
Home wait-info updates perform consistently (+1.3% across 10 tests) and address long waiting time and support reports.
Finish step has highest drop-off (64.8% conversion), but finish hints have historically shown negative performance (-0.6%).
Adding a verification flow adds heavy friction and adoption new_flow changes historically cause significant drop-off (-4.3%).
Choose path drop-off is moderate and hints show mild positive impact (+0.7%), though evidence from support is lacking.
Targets the lowest converting step (64.8%), and notifications on finish screen show positive historical trends (+0.9%).
High cost full redesign on waiting screen with weak confidence given redesigns consistently underperform across onboarding.
